name: Wretched Inquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Some inquisitors are not formally trained by their churches, but rather cruelly twisted by their enemies. At some point in her life, a wretched legendary inquisitor had been captured, imprisoned, and tortured for an extended period of time. When it comes to psychological torment and physical torture, a wretched legendary inquisitor learns from the best. Now a cynical shell of her old self, a wretched legendary inquisitor seeks new meaning through employment in their church.

Alignment: A wretched legendary inquisitor can have any non-good alignment.

Inquisition: A wretched legendary inquisitor must select the Imprisonment or Torture inquisition.

This alters domain.

Wretched (Ex)

No amount of healing, magical or otherwise, can ever restore a wretched legendary inquisitor to her old self. A wretched legendary inquisitor gains an oracle curse, treating her legendary inquisitor level as her oracle level.

This replaces monster lore.

Practical Measures (Ex)

Wretched inquisitors hate wasting time in combat. At 5th level, a wretched legendary inquisitor gains sneak attack as a slayer of her legendary inquisitor level -2.

This replaces bane and greater bane.

Why Do I Do This? (Ex)

At 9th level, a wretched legendary inquisitor experiences a personal crisis of faith, morality, and duty, making it difficult to sense even her own motivations.

She adds her Wisdom bonus to Bluff checks in addition to her Charisma bonus.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 9th level.

House of Questions (Sp)

At 17th level, a wretched legendary inquisitor adds legend lore to her list of spells known. If the subject of the spell is a person, the person is at hand, and the person is conscious, alive, and helpless, the wretched legendary inquisitor can torture the person as part of the 1d4 x 10 minute casting time. This torture does not need to be in the form of actual hit point damage.

The spell reveals legends on the target regardless of their level, as the helpless person is unable to save against this spell and they are forced to speak the desired information themselves.

This replaces slayer.
